name: n7-research-data-deposit-environment
description: Runtime for a university research data repository deposit.

tools.screen_dataset: Screens a dataset and records dataset_screened.
tools.mint_dataset_doi: Requires dataset_screened, mints a dataset DOI, and records doi_minted.
tools.publish_repository_record: Requires doi_minted, publishes the repository record, and records record_published.
